scope: Stage 3B-2 bounded delayed association candidates without event valuation, eligibility modulation or parameter update

representation.request_control: one graph-produced token coordinate selected by configuration
representation.result: stable historical event reference plus delay and normalized similarity

unassigned_reasons: zero query after removing request coordinate
no historical candidate in the delay window

compatibility.stage3b1_config_identity: unchanged because disabled association is canonically removed
compatibility.stage3b1_checkpoint: upgrade creates empty association metadata without fabricating links
compatibility.birth: newborn trace ring and delayed associations start empty
compatibility.clone_checkpoint_compaction: committed association metadata is copied exactly

forbidden: interpreting token similarity as credit, cause, correctness or value
using the request coordinate to improve similarity
persisting node IDs, edge IDs, activation masks or execution paths
changing local eligibility or graph parameters
claiming association candidates as learning, memory understanding or subjecthood
